acceptance: For each required check name, read latest check runs per suite (`check-runs?filter=latest`), preserving suite identity and Actions run URL; evaluate per suite, never via the deduplicated `gh pr checks` list. For a failed stale suite, locate its run and `gh run rerun <id> --failed`. Wire this into `pr_arm`/`pr_landing`/`green_unmerged_sweep`/`required_lane` (or one shared helper). Regression coverage: multiple suites sharing one check name including a stale failed suite hidden by a newer success; show it is identified and rerunnable. Document the #2829-style phantom-rollup close/reopen fallback.
context:
DONE 2026-10-24: PR #3393 merged as 85fb89967aee37d54a6ea605d92893f59ffe63ab (head 5c5804ed0, oracle SHIP; findings D1-D3 fixed and verified). New _project/scripts/check_suites.py reads check-runs?filter=latest with suite identity and evaluates each (name, suite) separately, flagging a failed suite hidden by a newer success. Required names come from the develop ruleset in pr_arm, pr_rerun, pr_landing, remote_closeout and the green-unmerged sweep (green_unmerged_sweep.py:460-495). make pr-arm refuses a PR with a hidden failed suite and prints its suite id and run URL; make pr-rerun re-runs every Actions run behind a failed required suite (--failed, or whole run when cancelled); the sweep lists hidden failures and never counts such a PR green; docs/agent/merge-authority.md documents stale suites and the close/reopen fallback. Tests: test_check_suites.py plus cases in pr_rerun, pr_arm, pr_landing, remote_closeout and sweep tests; mutation (grouping by name only) caught. Not exercised: a real stale-suite case through make pr-arm after merge.

AMENDED 2026-10-24 per Advisor review 2026-10-24 (/Users/joe/.cache/remaining-tasks-advice.md, claude-fable-5 high), approved by the owner: Merged in the 2026-10-23 finding that `gh pr checks --required` shows one result per check name and hides stale failed suites (#3319, #3339, #3362-#3370 all needed per-suite `check-runs?filter=latest` + `gh run rerun`). No repo tooling reads per-suite latest results: _project/scripts/green_unmerged_sweep.py:452,475-483, _project/scripts/required_lane.py:31-56, scripts/pr_landing.py:544,559-563; scripts/pr_rerun.py:91-101,144-167 reruns the newest full CI run, not a stale failed suite.

UPDATE 2026-10-23: recurred on PR #3319 (head 826e7e44c): auto-merge armed and every required check shown green by `gh pr checks --required`, yet BLOCKED for over an hour. That command shows one result per check name; the per-suite view (`gh api repos/BenchBox-dev/benchbox/commits/<sha>/check-runs?check_name=oracle-review&filter=latest`) showed three oracle-review suites (runs 39869415680, 39869421814, 39872378410) whose latest run was still failure. `gh run rerun` on those three merged the PR within a minute. Tooling gap: pr-arm and agent checks should read per-suite latest check runs, not the deduplicated list.

2026-10-22 recurrence on PR #3264 (head 68de1e483): every required context had a SUCCESS instance, but two superseded failed `oracle-review` check runs (Actions runs 39706240336, synchronize; 39711741625, pull_request_review) kept the required rollup at FAILURE and mergeStateStatus BLOCKED. Cancelled `gate` instances from the oracle-gate workflow's cancel-in-progress concurrency also show as failing in `gh pr checks`, though `gate` is not required. `make oracle-review-recover` could not help: it never finds failed runs (oracle-review-recover-finds-no-failed-runs-20261022). A manual `gh run rerun --failed` of both runs unblocked the merge.
